findings_disposition.subject: Terminal valuation-only price promotion corrected
findings_disposition.assessment: Terminal batch execution prices now come only from state.history[-1].close. last_marks remains a separate NAV-mark map. With a missing final close and a fresh valuation-only observation, the held asset is excluded from synthetic execution, remains held/marked and is reported as marked_residual_holdings rather than liquidated_cash. The terminal endpoint now reports its exclusion list. Existing cloned batch/state separation and valid-close sell-cost/rounding behavior are unchanged.
findings_disposition.proof: test_terminal_never_promotes_valuation_only_mark_to_execution passed in the focused slice: primary NAV 1200 and units A=100; terminal trades empty/cash zero/units A=100/NAV1200 with explicit missing_execution_open exclusion.

findings_disposition.classification: SHOWN exact source delta and two passing refusal regressions
findings_disposition.subject: Comparison carry binds benchmark identities and mix
findings_disposition.assessment: A normalized recipe contains btc_symbol, eth_symbol and weights() output. Every returned arm state gets its own deep-copied comparison_contract. On resume the complete four-arm state set and every stored recipe are checked before the arm simulation comprehension. Changed identities/mix and missing declarations refuse rather than silently retaining the old control under new parameters. Equivalent normalized weight representations compare consistently; original caller-defined candidate contract identity remains a separate documented responsibility.
findings_disposition.proof: The identity-swap and changed-mix cases each passed while simulate_shared_next_open was replaced by a forbidden stub, proving refusal occurs before any arm simulation. Existing unchanged-contract full-versus-split control equality regression also passed.

retained_risks: This is a bounded correction review, not a new general proof of all financial or integration behavior. The original review's unaffected positive assessment and limits remain applicable.
One venue/common quote, no cash yield/FX/financing and causal unchanged caller targets/correctly interpreted dated inputs remain modelling assumptions.

A valid valuation can preserve marked residual NAV without making an asset executable. A terminal COMPLETE label can still include unsold holdings; profit_basis and exclusions must be retained by consumers.

The terminal exclusion uses the shared batch reason missing_execution_open even though the synthetic terminal execution input is a close-price map; the terminal qualification and preserved units make the boundary explicit.
Old comparison states lacking comparison_contract now fail closed. Exact Fraction types and normalized recipe data must survive caller persistence; no migration/checkpoint serializer was introduced.
Caller target_contract_id is not an automatic source hash or sandbox for candidate-callable external state.

Historical permissions/precision, actual fills, liquidity/partial fills/latency/queue/capacity, strategy economics and production integration remain UNVERIFIED. Synthetic acceptance authorizes no experiment, market-data run, funds or trading.
